newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian relief crew enters troubled Mir.
newsitem.headline: Russian relief crew enters troubled Mir.

text.p: Two Russian cosmonauts joined the accident-prone three-man crew of the crippled Mir space station on Thursday after a difficult but successful docking of their Soyuz spacecraft.
Live television pictures showed the cosmonauts embracing each other inside Mir after hatches between Soyuz and Mir were opened.

The hatches were opened at 1830 GMT, as scheduled. The television pictures showed the cosmonauts working on cables and floating in Mir's weightlessness. They were securing bolts, clearly making final touches to the link-up between Soyuz and Mir. There was no clear sound.
Earlier on Thursday the Soyuz spacecraft docked with Mir but the relief crew had to carry out the operation manually after automatic systems developed a fault, officials at Mission Control said.
